title: Custom Robotic Arm
description: Multi-joint robotic arm focused on mechanical design, actuator selection, manipulation, inverse kinematics, joint control, motion planning, and future computer-vision-guided autonomy.
imageAlt: Current physical prototype of Aakarsh Sangar's custom robotic arm with gripper and wiring

title: ModalAI Drone Systems Project
description: Hands-on autonomous drone integration project using a VOXL 2 Mini-based platform: hardware assembly, wiring repair, QGroundControl configuration, VOXL camera bring-up, camera calibration, thrust tuning, documentation, and flight testing.
imageAlt: ModalAI drone platform with carbon frame, prop guards, battery, and onboard camera

title: Jetson Orin Nano Robotics Platform
description: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano robotics computing platform currently being used for an embedded VLA model for the robotic arm, with the goal of using computer vision to detect a block's color and pick it up when prompted. I have also used the Jetson platform for rPPG pipeline experimentation.
imageAlt: Jetson Orin Nano robotics platform setup

title: Faultline
description: Multi-agent research tool created at CalHacks AI Hackathon to analyze academic literature, identify conflicting claims between papers, summarize findings, compare methods, and propose validation experiments.

images.alt: Faultline typed message exchange and agent event dashboard

title: Vision-Based Health Monitoring System
description: Computer vision approach for estimating physiological signals from camera input, exploring remote photoplethysmography and non-contact heart-rate monitoring through an rPPG pipeline tested with the Jetson Orin Nano platform.

title: FIRST / FTC Robotics
description: Competition robot design, build, and testing through iterative mechanical and electrical development with mechanisms, motors, sensors, and integrated robot systems.
